title: RT by @polychain: This fully autonomous demo shows a Bagel Labs foundation model controlling a robot to make coffee. We previously released WorldDiT, our lightweight architecture for robot foundation models. At the time of release, it was on the Pareto frontier for model size and performance. We have since been refining this architecture to handle longer horizon, more useful tasks fully autonomously. Making coffee means getting a whole sequence of actions right. Each step depends on the result of the last, so small mistakes can build up as the task continues. Getting this to work with a small model is especially challenging. This demo is an example of what the model can do today. If you are deploying robots or have existing hardware you want to make autonomous, we would like to partner with you. https://bagel.com/partner

name: SemiAnalysis
title: R to @SemiAnalysis_: Vlex glass has a CTE of 2.0 parts per million per degree Celsius between 50°C and 200°C. That is lower than its T glass at 2.8, NE glass at 3.3, and conventional E glass at 5.6. Vlex has a tensile modulus of 71 GPa, placing it above NE glass but below the stiffer T glass. At 10 GHz, its dielectric constant is 4.7 and its dissipation factor is 0.0043. These figures suggest a material aimed at balancing dimensional stability, mechanical properties, and electrical performance. (2/2)
